beats.line: of course you continue anyway since this message is obviously meant for someone else
as you push deeper into the cave with your underwater scooter
you'll soon come across the most dangerous section of passage simply called the pit
this tight confined area requires divers
to carefully squeeze and twist their bodies through
without damaging their gear. It's not uncommon for divers to take multiple attempts
just to successfully pass through a single gap. Now
would also be a great time to mention the deadly stat:
this cave has claimed the lives of dozens of divers here
